Description: The purpose of this project is to introduce an advanced, real-time, on-site disease detection system for pig farms, integrating with existing digital tools to detect harmful pathogens early, enabling quicker interventions, healthier pigs and more efficient farming practices.

Title: Commercialising Therapeutic, Artificially Intelligent Companions
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: This project aims to advance the development and commercialization of Digitally Embodied, Artificially Intelligent Companions to provide psychosocial and/or therapeutic support for mental health and wellbeing.

Title: Circular Economy Mortar
Description: This project aims to develop a new, removable mortar using carbon-negative ingredients from agricultural straw waste, which allows easy debonding from bricks and blocks, reduces carbon emissions, and meets Australian Building Standards.

Title: A Ternary Neural Network Accelerator
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a prototype AI accelerator based on ternary neural networks to reduce cost, power consumption, and execution time for modern AI systems, while maintaining accuracy.

Title: Dual bovine venereal disease vaccine proof-of-concept trial
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a dual vaccine for bovine genital campylobacteriosis and bovine trichomonosis to improve the competitiveness of the Australian beef industry by ensuring cattle are free from venereal diseases.

Title: A novel medical device (LesioLogic) to improve catheter ablation outcomes in treating lethal heart rhythm disorders
Description: The purpose of this project is to improve treatment efficacy for heart rhythm disorders by providing real-time, non-invasive feedback to physicians on treatment quality, reducing the need for repeat treatments and enhancing patients' quality of life.

Title: High throughput screening of compounds to abate cattle-derived methane emissions
Description: The purpose of this project is to automate and miniaturise the process of screening algae strains to reduce methane emissions from ruminants, providing a faster and more efficient way to contribute to sustainable agriculture and environmental protection.

Title: Advancing Australian Innovation: Manufacturing Nasal Delivery Psychoactive Drugs for Unmet Mental Health Needs
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop and manufacture innovative nasal spray dosage forms of combined psychedelic compounds for treating mental health disorders, aiming to provide effective new options for conditions like depression, anxiety and addiction.

Title: Implementation of a low-cost spectroscopic sensing solution for autonomous farm management
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a field-portable, low-cost, robust instrument that uses infrared light (via near infrared spectroscopy) to assess the health of crops, soil, and plants.

Title: Fluorescence Fingerprint enabled High-density Optical Data Storage
Description: The purpose of this project is to dramatically increase digital data storage capacities by developing ultra-high density optical media using nanocrystalline materials and novel data writing techniques.

Title: Demonstrating low-cost green hydrogen production from raw water through scale-up of novel patent pending electrolysis technology
Description: The purpose of this project is to revolutionise the production of low-cost green hydrogen by demonstrating a commercially attractive hydrogen production pathway that can be scaled across Australia, enabling transformative impacts in transportation, energy storage, fertiliser production, and critical minerals processing, while co-producing fresh water for communities.

Title: An AI-Based Smart Phone System for inexpensive and fast Asbestos Identification
Description: This project aims to improve an AI-based image recognition system for Asbestos Identification, using a clip-on microscope to deliver faster, more accurate, and cost-effective asbestos identification.

Title: Advanced Manufacturing of Environmentally Friendly PFAS-Free Non-Stick Optical Coatings
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop cutting-edge technology for manufacturing environmentally friendly, PFAS-free, non-stick coatings specifically for optical applications.

Title: Towards digital genetic plant pathogen surveillance and smart chemical disease control in agriculture
Description: The purpose of this project is to apply digital genetic "fingerprint" technology to crop pathogens, guiding smarter chemical control of crop diseases to save millions for growers and the economy while being more economic and better for the environment.

Title: Sustainable future fuels: Advancing duckweed feedstock
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop and test new technology to grow duckweed as a sustainable source of biomass using nutrient-rich waste residue from treated dairy manure, aiming to produce scalable amounts of biomass for biofuel production without impacting food production.

Title: Local Positioning Service (LPS)
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a superior Positioning Solution that enhances Australia’s capabilities in critical sectors like robotics, transport, defense, and agriculture by improving transport safety, mitigating GPS-related risks in defense and boosting precision farming.

Title: A Robust Chemical Sensing Platform for Optimized Process Control in Mineral Processing Operations
Description: The purpose of this project is to extend the technology readiness of newly patented slurry sampling chips to achieve continuous chemical monitoring in harsh process streams with high concentrations of particles, enabling timely decisions at the processing plant and opening future opportunities for advanced process control through machine learning strategies.

Title: High Energy, Safe and Recyclable Single Electrode Supercapacitors
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a new type of energy storage device known as an anode-less supercapacitor, aiming to create a more efficient, reliable, safe, and cost-effective supercapacitor by eliminating the anode and optimising other aspects of the device.

Title: Advanced Manufacturing of Hard Carbon from Agricultural Waste for Sodium-Ion Batteries
Description: The purpose of this project is to enhance the production of materials for sodium-ion batteries by scaling up a microwave technology method to convert agricultural waste into high-quality carbon materials, aiming to develop and test new battery cells that match or exceed the performance of current commercial batteries.

Title: Chip Integration for Advanced Fibre Sensors
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: This project aims to use Australian rapid prototyping capabilities to demonstrate the potential benefits of photonic integration for advanced optical fibre sensors, allowing for the assessment of these benefits in a real-world industrial context.

Title: Advanced Inspection of Next-Generation Solar Cells: Integrating Novel Characterisation Methods with AI
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to commercialise advanced characterisation methods and machine learning algorithms for next-generation solar cells, developed in collaboration with BT Imaging, to enhance device efficiency and optimise fabrication processes.

Title: X-Retina: A Real-time Cloud-based AI-vision and Cognitive Factory Digital Twin to Maximise Plastic Recycling
Description: The purpose of the X-Retina project is to transform the recycling industry by developing advanced AI-driven vision modules and a cloud-based factory digital twin platform that boosts plastic recycling efficiency and profitability.

Title: A photonic rheometer for blood characterisation
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop and test a compact, user-friendly, and portable device using quantum-based sensors to provide clinicians with quick, vital, personalised information for better bleeding management during surgery and related procedures.

Title: Resorbable Patient-Specific Orthopaedic Implants
Description: The purpose of this project is to assess the repeatability of the 3D printing process for orofacial implants using a novel biodegradable zinc alloy, aiming to create patient-specific implants that naturally dissolve over time, eliminating the need for additional surgeries and improving the quality of life for patients.

Title: Scale-Up Advanced Manufacturing of Functional Feed Ingredients from Cane Molasses Towards Commercialisation
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop and scale up the production of Fructooligosaccharides (FOS) from low-value sugarcane molasses using advanced biomanufacturing to enhance livestock health, improve productivity, and potentially reduce methane emissions.

Title: Dual function paint coatings: cool-roof and water capture for a sustainable future
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop novel dual-function paint coatings that provide heat relief and water security in the face of climate change by cooling buildings, reducing the urban heat island effect, and collecting water from the atmosphere through condensation.

Title: Manufacturing automated microscopes for rapid Antibiotic Susceptibility Testing
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a rapid Antimicrobial Susceptibility Testing platform using single bacteria counting on an automated, innovative microscope to detect potential antibiotic resistance as soon as possible.

Title: Lithium ore quality and quantity detection using novel fluorescence sensing
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a prototype "novel fluorescence" spodumene sensor to detect and quantify spodumene in raw ore, enabling selective mining processes that minimise economic and environmental costs.

Title: AI-enabled novel software platform for accelerated design of fit-for-purpose polymeric materials
Description: This project aims to accelerate the timeline for translating newly discovered materials into deployable manufactured products by creating an AI-enabled software tool that integrates experimental data with computational tools and AI algorithms.

Title: AI-Powered Data Input Technology to Enhance Staff Retention and Care Quality in the Aged Care Industry
Description: The purpose of this project is to automate data entry with advanced AI technology to free up time for resident care, improve job satisfaction and care quality, and reduce staff turnover, recruitment and training costs.

Title: 3D Printed High-Performance Electrodes for Sustainable Fuel and Clean Energy Generation Systems
Description: The purpose of this project is to use patent-pending technologies to 3D print optimised electrodes for clean energy generation systems, aiming to break current barriers to energy efficiency and extend the hydrogen and sustainable fuel economy to unique applications.

Title: SerpenSeal, next generation wound management
Description: This project aims to develop a platform wound technology called SerpenSeal, based on potent snake venom-derived factors, to control both surgical and traumatic bleeding, even in the presence of clotting failure, and to establish Australian-based manufacturing of wound care products with Indigenous Australian Industry partner Bulugudu.

Title: Developing Digital Battery Passport Platform to Support Australia’s Circular Economy
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop an AI-enhanced, robust, scalable, and secure cloud-based platform for managing Digital Battery Passports, ensuring transparency, traceability, and compliance with regulatory and environmental standards to support Australia’s circular economy.

Title: Sustainable diesel production from CO2
Description: The purpose of this project is to derisk and demonstrate groundbreaking advancements in a single-step process for the production of Green Diesel, significantly reducing carbon emissions from mining operations and assisting in decarbonising our economy.

Title: Securing the future of the iconic Australian banana industry
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop technology to bring to market a multi-disease resistant Cavendish banana, QCAV-4, which is resistant to Fusarium wilt TR4 and other diseases, aiming to reduce production costs, tackle high fungicide use, protect the industry, and give Australia a leading commercial edge in the global market.

Title: Transforming Waste: Engineered Yeast Valorizing Black Soldier Fly Waste Streams for High-value Biofuels and Cosmetics
Description: The purpose of this project is to transform complex waste into high-value cosmetic oils and biofuels using engineered yeast strains, offering a sustainable alternative to traditional methods.

Title: BrainAssure: A low-cost, electrochemical-sensor-based, point-of-care system for diagnosing dementia
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop an affordable and highly sensitive tool to monitor brain health by detecting neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels, which are key markers for neurological disorders and dementia.

Title: Advancing a digital tool for improved water decision-making in agriculture
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a commercial tool that integrates costs with physical on-farm data in real time to improve irrigation decision-making across multiple crop types, supporting growers across Australia.

Title: Intelligent Reflecting Surface Antenna for Digital Mining
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop innovative antenna technologies using intelligent reflecting surface antennas (RSAs) to provide low-cost, ubiquitous wireless connectivity in underground mining sites, significantly improving mining productivity and safety.

Title: Machine Learning Methods for Advanced Photoluminescence Image Data Analysis
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to use artificial intelligence-based image processing techniques to analyze photoluminescence images generated by aerial drone systems, enhancing the inspection of solar panels by increasing throughput, reducing costs and mitigating the need for highly trained specialists.

Title: Artificial intelligence-driven, context-aware wearables for falls prevention in the real world
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a wearable medical device that enables better assessment and management of falls risk, ultimately reducing falls and related hospitalisations and deaths in Australia.

Title: Developing a web app "Baby Moves VIEW" for cerebral palsy screening
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a web application called "Baby Moves VIEW" to help screen more babies for cerebral palsy as early as 4 months old, ensuring they receive early play-based therapy programs at a critical time to improve their outcomes.

Title: Innovative high-pressure hydrogen injection technologies for diesel vehicle retrofit solutions
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to accelerate the commercialisation of hydrogen-diesel hybrid technologies by developing essential components for successful integration into mobile diesel systems, thereby enhancing the durability and efficiency of hydrogen injectors and expanding the technology's applications to longer-range transport vehicles.

Title: Graphene-enhanced netting: A cost-effective solution to prevent biofouling in aquaculture
Description: The purpose of this project is to revolutionise the aquaculture industry by developing a graphene-enhanced material for fish-pen nets to reduce biofouling, lower operational costs, improve environmental sustainability and enhance food security.

Title: Digital twin enabled qualification of parts for additive manufacturing
Description: The purpose of this project is to raise the technological readiness of our approach to the certification and qualification of metal parts made by 3D printing processes or additive manufacturing.

Title: Next generation extrusion dies produced by additive manufacturing
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: The purpose of this project is to enable the next generation of extrusion dies to be manufactured using 3D printing, significantly improving their design, performance, durability, and reducing the cost of manufacture.

Title: Development of ResectAssist™: a drug-eluting implantable device for the localised treatment for pancreatic cancer
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop ResectAssist™, a single-use, implantable drug-eluting device for inoperable locally advanced pancreatic cancer, aiming to locally deliver high dose chemotherapy to convert non-resectable pancreatic tumours to resectable, thereby improving patient outcomes and addressing an important unmet medical need.

Title: Scaling up percrystallisation technology for advanced manufacturing of metal compounds and zero-liquid discharge applications
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a new crystallisation technology using special membranes to produce high-quality industrial materials more efficiently, reducing costs and energy usage, and enhancing Australia's competitiveness in manufacturing battery materials and other valuable chemical products.

Title: AI-empowered smart depot charging for fleet electrification
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: The purpose of this project is to offer an AI-empowered smart depot charging solution that optimizes charger utilisation, integrates renewable energy sources, and provides data-driven insights to accelerate the adoption of electric fleets and contribute to a sustainable transportation sector.

Title: Advanced Manufacturing of Blood Vessel Bioreactor
Description: The purpose of this project is to pilot and evaluate a novel lab model of the human vasculature, called blood-vessel-in-a-box, which closely mimics human physiological conditions to improve the assessment of medical devices and pharmaceuticals.

Title: Manufacturing a novel device to improve detection of fetal asphyxia in labour
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a commercial-grade device using a novel pH nanosensor to continuously detect fetal pH during labour, aiming to improve the diagnostic accuracy of fetal hypoxia and reduce the risk of birth asphyxia.

Title: Terahertz virtual skin biopsy: Quantum cascade laser imaging of early melanoma
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop and bring to clinical use a quantum imaging platform based on Terahertz (THz) Quantum Cascade Lasers to improve the early diagnosis and reduce the overdiagnosis of melanoma.

Title: Catalytic Hydrogen Production via Pyrolysis (CHyPP)
Description: The purpose of this project is to demonstrate and advance a revolutionary low-emission hydrogen production technology by optimising catalysts used to pyrolyse methane into hydrogen and valuable solid carbon byproducts.

Title: Developing an Artificial Intelligence-Augmented Device for Non-Surgical Assessment of Elevated Intracranial Pressure
Description: The purpose of this project is to create a portable, non-invasive tool for detecting elevated intracranial pressure using advanced artificial intelligence to analyze videos captured from the back of the eye, enhancing diagnostic speed and accuracy, and ensuring broader access to the latest medical technology.

Title: Optimising ore-sand as a scalable circular economy solution to reduce mineral wastes and responsibly supply alternative construction materials - Stage II
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a circular economy solution to address the sustainability challenges of tailings waste and sand extraction in the mining industry by reducing tailings waste and creating fit-for-purpose mining by-products known as ore-sand.

Title: Sustainable Alternatives to Synthetic Superabsorbent Polymers for Hydroseeding and Hydromulch Applications
Description: The purpose of this project is to advance the UQ Biogel technology by optimizing its performance and large-scale production for hydromulch and hydroseeding, with product validation in plot trials, to enhance sustainability and the circular economy across various applications.

Title: SkyOwl, a Multi-Agent Training Assistant
Description: The purpose of this project is to provide a portable, multi-agent AI tool called SkyOwl that helps aviation professionals develop key communication and decision-making skills, thereby increasing safety outcomes and streamlining training.

Title: AI-powered Media Disinformation and Cyber Security Defence Training Platform
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to integrate the existing AI agent-based mis- and disinformation platform into TLRs Cyber War Games platform, providing hands-on training opportunities for future cybersecurity professionals to understand and mitigate modern cybersecurity threats.

Title: Smart Inventory Solution- Leveraging AI for Sustainable and ESG-Complaint Inventory Management
Description: The purpose of the Smart Inventory Solution project is to revolutionize inventory management for small and medium-sized businesses through an AI-powered platform that optimizes inventory control while adhering to Environmental, Social, and Governance compliance standards.

Title: Novel Biotechnology for Anaerobic Algae Fermentation Yielding Sustainable Liquid Biofuels
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to enhance the production of high-value bioethanol from algae through advanced anaerobic fermentation, addressing waste issues while yielding renewable liquid bioenergy to meet Australia's growing energy demands.

Title: A Novel Bimodal Small Molecule That Reinvigorates Tired T-Cells To Fight Melanoma
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop an innovative drug, BT2, as a novel “bimodal” therapeutic for cancer, aiming to inhibit kinase activation in cancer cells and PD-1 levels on T cells, potentially transforming current therapy to reduce morbidity and mortality from melanoma and other cancers.

Title: AI-Powered Image Technologies for Advanced Fish Breeding and Farm Efficiency
Description: The purpose of this project is to revolutionise fish farming by developing an AI-powered tool named AutoFish, which accurately assesses essential fish traits such as color, size, and weight using images and videos.

Title: MapTalk: A conversational AI assistant for geospatial data analytics
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: The purpose of this project is to enable anyone to create insights from complex data by asking questions in everyday language, thereby democratising data analysis and boosting industry productivity and efficiency.

Title: Zero-Emission Safer Roads for Rural and Regional Road Systems
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: The purpose of this project is to introduce a zero-emission, cost-effective construction method using recycled materials and green bio-additives to arrest damages induced by problematic soils, thereby improving the resilience of remote and regional communities reliant on the road system.

Title: Vision BaDGE electro-lens delivery of naked VEGFscav DNA is the future for wet-AMD eye disease therapy
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a new technology for safe, painless delivery of naked DNA encoding a VEGF scavenger protein to the sclera of the eye using a single brief electric pulse, aiming to achieve long-term treatment for wet age-related macular degeneration (wetAMD) and related neovascularisation disorders.

Title: The Monash Phage Foundry to manufacture clinical-grade phage products.
Description: The purpose of this project is to improve access to life-saving phage therapy in Australia by establishing a local manufacturing facility with the capacity for large-scale production of clinical-grade phage products.

Title: AI-Enabled Anti-Spoofing for RF Device Authentication via Satellite Sensing
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: The purpose of this project is to enhance wireless device security by developing advanced AI-enabled software for authentication using satellite technology, significantly improving wireless visibility and security.

Title: The Green Bundle: Integrated Hydrogen Storage and Delivery with Carbon Dioxide Conversion to Green Methane
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a tandem and green process capable of enabling the large-scale storage and generation of hydrogen, and converting carbon dioxide into green methane.

Title: Low-cost sensing for liquid food supply chain authentication
Description: The purpose of this project is to combat supply chain fraud in Australia's liquid food products by developing a portable and low-cost digital agriculture solution that fingerprints liquid food products at the source, providing a unique digital signature traceable throughout the entire supply chain as proof of origin and authenticity.

Title: Multiplexed amino acid and pH biosensor array for in vitro sample qualification and optimisation
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a biocompatible dual-purpose aptamer biosensor for amino acids and pH, aiming to transform the biological sample preparation and production workflow by marketing a user-friendly and fit-for-purpose biosensor array.

Title: Intelligent Agent for Efficient and Effective Frequency Control Ancillary Services Targeting Renewable Energy Power Systems
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop an intelligent agent for solar power systems to deliver low-cost, effective Frequency Control Ancillary Services, enhancing energy efficiency, extending the lifespan of energy storage systems, reducing electricity costs, and improving the stability and efficiency of the national grid.

Title: Advanced Chemistry and Manufacturing of a Novel Peptide-Drug Conjugate
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a new peptide-drug conjugate designed to treat triple-negative breast cancer by targeting cancer cells more specifically, potentially offering a more effective therapy with high tolerability compared to current treatments.

Title: Validation of Dynamic Interface Printing for high-throughput manufacturing of biological tissue models
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a novel biofabrication technology known as Dynamic Interface Printing to create precise, reproducible, and consistent tissue models of human disease.

Title: Piezoelectric paints for next-generation smart buildings
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a piezoelectric paint that can detect intrusions and generate power from mechanical force, enhancing building security and sustainability.

Title: Novel Hybrid Direct Air Capture Technology Enabling Distributed 100% Green Methanol Production
Description: The purpose of this project is to revolutionise green methanol production by combining solar thermal Direct Air Capture with methanol synthesis, creating a cost-effective and scalable process to produce 100% green methanol

Title: Renewable hydrogen production from indirect raw water electrolysis
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop an innovative raw water electrolysis system using a Membrane Distillation Heat Exchanger – Water Treatment Module (MDHX-WTM) to simplify water utilization and recycling, reduce costs, and support Australia's renewable hydrogen production.

Title: Innovative Gas Sensor for Low-Emission Energy Applications
Description: This project aims to develop an innovative gas sensor that enhances safety for industries transitioning to hydrogen as a clean energy source by quickly and accurately detecting hydrogen leaks.

Title: Advanced manufacturing of therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals for targeted cancer treatment
Description: This project aims to develop scalable, cost-effective manufacturing methods for therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals to enable centralised and commercially viable production and distribution, improving access to cancer therapies for people in rural and regional areas.

Title: Advanced injection molding for scalable manufacturing of high-throughput 3D microfluidic devices
Description: This project aims to develop and validate an advanced injection molding and automated assembly process to simplify the efficient, scalable production of complex 3D microfluidic structures, enhancing and accelerating the commercialization of biomedical microtechnologies.

Title: Rescuing crucial frontline antibiotics for treatment of multidrug-resistant bacterial infections
Description: This project aims to advance the development of a therapeutic that can rescue the efficacy of macrolide antibiotics against community-acquired bacterial pneumonia infections.

Title: Commercialisation of Mobile AI Tool for Real-time Characterisation of Mine Waste Materials
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to advance SCANDY, an artificial intelligence tool for real-time mine waste characterisation, helping to transform waste management in the mining industry through accurate, unbiased assessments and enhanced decision-making.

Title: Accelerating Cultured Fish Meat Production
Description: The purpose of this project is to provide tropical fish cell lines and growth media that increase scale and reduce costs during cultivated fish meat manufacturing, enabling the generation of cultivated fish meat for pet-food and human consumption for the Asian market.

Title: A novel BioC-H2 process for hydrogen and carbon nano material (CNM) production from biogas
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: The purpose of this project is to demonstrate and validate the BioC-H2 process performance at a TRL 5 stage, showcasing its ability to transform biogas into energy-rich hydrogen gas and high-value carbon nano materials.

Title: Reliable AI-Driven Decision Making for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles in Marine Life Surveys
Description: The purpose of this project is to integrate cutting-edge AI technology with advanced autonomous underwater vehicle systems to enhance the monitoring and analysis of marine life, particularly for sustainable fisheries practices

Title: Innovative, ultra-efficient device for sustainable electricity harvesting from CO2
Description: The purpose of this project is to leverage the ion separation technique to generate usable electricity from the CO2 amine adsorption process, transforming industrial waste into a valuable resource and reducing Australia's overall carbon footprint.

Title: Reducing losses from illegal fishing through satellite-based small boat detection
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a highly accurate Artificial Intelligence system that can automatically locate small boats within remote maritime borders using optical satellite images, to improve monitoring of illegal fishing and reduce associated economic losses and monitoring costs.

Title: Scalable, Long-Range, Quantum-Secure Communications for Critical Communications Infrastructure
Description: The purpose of this project is to revolutionise secure digital communication by developing an innovative quantum communications system to fortify and future-proof digital information between critical Australian communications infrastructure.

Title: Health Status Estimation and Resilient Closed-loop Supply Chain for Retired Electric Vehicle Batteries
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to create a sustainable and efficient method to recycle and reuse batteries from electric vehicles to support Australia’s energy needs.

Title: Breaking barriers: developing biofilm inhibitors to combat antimicrobial resistance
Description: The purpose of this project is to use antibody-based inhibitors to disrupt UPEC biofilms, preventing biofilm formation, dismantling existing biofilms, and enhancing the effectiveness of antibiotics to address the critical unmet need of treating urinary tract infections and combating antimicrobial resistance.

Title: GreenWave: Accelerated Perovskite Solar Cell Production with Machine Learning and Eco-Solvents
Description: The purpose of this project is to transform the manufacturing of perovskite solar cells by developing a green, high-throughput production process using advanced machine learning.

Title: A Novel Robot for Ankle Neurorehabilitation of Patients with Post-Stroke Disabilities
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a new ankle rehabilitation robot that assesses the disability level of individual patients and provides customised rehabilitation to improve lower limb movement and address drop foot issues.

Title: Synthesis of a Novel Nanoparticle-Bispecific Immunotherapy Platform to Treat Breast and Skin Cancer
Description: The purpose of this project is to advance a new type of cancer treatment using a patented nanoparticle-bispecific immunotherapy platform that targets breast and skin cancers, aiming to improve patient outcomes and reduce healthcare costs.

Title: Developing stem cell villages in a dish to develop new therapeutics for retinal diseases
Description: The purpose of this project is to use patient stem cell-derived models to discover novel therapeutics for neurodegenerative diseases, particularly blinding diseases, by optimizing methods to grow "retinal villages" and applying machine-learning methods for more precise and personalized treatments.

Title: Rapid and Affordable Imaging for Identification of Grass Seed Infestation in Australian Sheep
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a rapid and affordable scanning technology using terahertz waves and artificial intelligence to identify grass seed infestation in Australian sheep, enhancing productivity and quality management in the industry.

Title: AI-Enhanced Haptically-Enabled Robot for Teleoperated Echocardiography
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop an AI-enhanced teleoperated robot for heart ultrasound examinations, enabling heart specialists in major cities to perform ultrasound examinations on patients in regional or remote Australia.

Title: A Breath Ketone Sensor for Non-invasive Monitoring of Diabetes and Metabolic Health
Description: The purpose of this project is to revolutionise ketone monitoring for both humans and animals by developing a portable, non-invasive, and cost-effective breath ketone sensor, the Keto-whistle, to enable real-time, at-home, or in-field metabolic health diagnosis and monitoring.

Title: A solid state nanopore sensor for rapid, inexpensive, and non-invasive early-stage detection of Alzheimer’s disease.
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a low-cost blood test for early detection and monitoring of Alzheimer's disease, aiming to improve healthcare outcomes, reduce costs, and enhance accessibility, especially for rural and remote areas.

Title: A Novel Drug Treatment for Fibrotic Disease
Description: The purpose of this project is to enhance the preclinical package of CIN244, a 'first-in-class' antifibrotic developed by Cincera Therapeutics, to better understand its role in halting fibrosis, guide its therapeutic use, predict adverse effects, and identify patient groups most likely to benefit from the drug.

Title: SPARK: Designing Sovereign Pedagogical AI for Reinforcing Knowledge in Australian Education
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to safely harness the benefits of generative AI in education by utilising proprietary datasets to improve large language models with pedagogical guardrails and content moderation, ultimately helping students arrive at solutions independently.

Title: Future-proofing Against Resistant Bacterial Priority Pathogens: Innovative Formulations to Treat Infections and Save Lives
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a new antibacterial compound, NCL195, to combat drug-resistant bacteria and address the growing threat of antimicrobial resistance.

Title: Digitally-targeted yeast bioprospecting for non-alcoholic beer to value add to Australian agriculture
Description: The purpose of this project is to build upon previous work to identify and select five new non-genetically modified yeast strains from the Australian wilderness, using digital technologies and machine learning, to improve the production of non-alcoholic beer.

Title: OzAmmonia: Closing the Waste NOx Cycle via Green Ammonia Production, Powered by Renewable Energy in Australia
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to improve the Technology Readiness Level of the OzAmmonia system by developing an integrated system to convert waste nitrogen oxide emissions (NOx) from renewable ammonia/hydrogen combustion engines into renewable ammonia, thereby enhancing efficiency and reducing environmental impact.

Title: Digital Twins in Agriculture: Virtual Farm Model for Enhancing Crop Health, Productivity, and Sustainability
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop an innovative digital twin (DT) platform for improved decision-making to foster canola and vineyard production, leveraging the Internet of Things and DT to create virtual farm models and predictive insights for enhanced crop health and farm sustainability.

Title: Indigo Revolution: Australia's Sustainable Dye
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to produce indigo through microbial fermentation, eliminating the need for toxic chemicals and enabling more environmentally friendly dyeing processes.

Title: Project “Iron Wheat”: Research and commercialisation of a new wheat variety in Australia which offers higher crop yield and improved feed conversion in poultry
Description: The purpose of this project is to improve Australian wheat yields and poultry health by advancing the research and commercialisation of a genetically modified wheat variety developed at The University of Melbourne, known as Iron Wheat.

Title: Developing lead-free perovskites for low-cost and environmentally friendly solar panels
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop environmentally friendly solar panels by substituting hazardous lead with non-toxic tin, enabling efficient and green photovoltaic technologies for solar energy harvesting.

Title: Preventing food poisoning with plasma activated water
Description: The purpose of this project is to revolutionise the egg washing process by using plasma-activated water as an eco-friendly sanitser, aiming to create a safer, more sustainable method that reduces the need for harmful chemicals and conserves water.

Title: Realising Net Zero Emissions - An Affordable Concentrated Solar Thermal (CST) Demonstrator for Industry and Agriculture
Description: The purpose of this project is to fabricate and assemble a CST Demonstrator with two full-size solar thermal modules, using innovative plastic mirrors to reduce costs and make renewable industrial process solar heat more accessible and affordable, thereby contributing to achieving Net Zero emissions.

Title: Printable zinc ion batteries for flexible devices
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop and scale up flexible, printed zinc-ion batteries using advanced screen printing techniques, offering a cheaper, more sustainable alternative to lithium batteries and positioning Australia as a key player in the growing flexible battery market.

Title: Advanced manufacturing of non-invasive AI-enabled brain monitor: towards a medical device to reverse paralysis
Description: The purpose of this project is to transform rehabilitation for individuals with spinal cord injury through the BioSpine system, an innovative medical device designed to re-establish neuronal connections between the brain and muscles.

Title: AI-Powered Future Prediction Tool for Rail Transport Asset Management
Description: The purpose of this project is to revolutionise condition monitoring in rail transport asset management by combining advanced mathematical modelling with real-world performance data to provide real-time, highly detailed insights into locomotive condition.

Title: Non-invasive technology for gender determination of fertilised chicken eggs before incubation
Description: The purpose of this project is to construct a device that can non-invasively determine the sex of fertilised chicken eggs before incubation, reducing costs, improving animal welfare, and decreasing the carbon footprint of the poultry industry.

Title: Machine learning prediction of patient ventilator asynchrony
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a machine-learning algorithm that detects when ventilator-assisted patients' breathing cycles become "out of synch" with the ventilator, allowing clinicians to adjust settings for better support, improving usage, quality of life, and survival for patients with conditions like motor-neuron disease.

Title: AI-based 3D scanning and analysis technologies for healthcare and industry
Description: The purpose of this project is to advance the core 3D scan processing technology by developing and integrating an AI-driven 3D processing and analysis system, resulting in an adaptive scanning technology with AI deep learning capabilities for higher scan-fidelity and more accurate 3D analyses.

Title: Scalable purification of viral vectors by metal affinity chromatography
Description: The purpose of this project is to enhance local vaccine manufacturing by using technology developed at the Australian National University to add protein tags to viruses, allowing for the removal of unwanted cellular debris and resulting in a purer vaccine stock.

Title: Manufacture of multiwell cartridges for high-throughput screening of phospholipase biomarkers in clinical samples.
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a 96-well plate with tethered bilayer lipid membrane technology to identify the presence of phospholipase A2 in human stool samples, aiming to improve screening for bowel cancers and inflammatory bowel diseases by reducing false-positive results and unnecessary gastrointestinal endoscopies.

Title: Manufacturing a High-Performance Radiopharmaceutical Product
Description: The purpose of this project is to collaboratively develop a new targeted ligand therapy agent named D2, focusing on improving its manufacturing efficiency, cost, product stability, and performance to enhance cancer treatment options and positively impact the future Australian economy and society.

Title: Bioadhesives for Underwater Applications
Description: The purpose of this project is to optimize underwater bioadhesives, partly made from plant waste, for coral reef restoration and marine industry applications, aiming to protect and restore marine ecosystems while supporting the global ocean economy.

Title: IMAGENDO® – Revolutionising Endometriosis Diagnosis with Machine Learning and Imaging
Description: The purpose of this project is to advance the functional prototype of IMAGENDO®, a non-surgical diagnostic system for endometriosis, to a regulatory-ready diagnostic tool.

Title: Quantum Automation for Cyber Defence
Description: The purpose of this project is to validate a novel quantum computing solution for early detection and automatic response to cyber threats, leveraging quantum principles and artificial intelligence to enhance cyber defense capabilities.

Title: New Carbon Fibre Recycling Process
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to create Australia's first recycling facility that produces high-quality carbon fibre recycled material from retired aircrafts, wind turbines, and consumer goods, turning waste into a valuable resource and demonstrating its commercial potential.

Title: Production of clinical-grade red blood cell extracellular vesicles (RBC-EV) to modulate neuroinflammation in the treatment of retinal degenerative diseases
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a manufacturing pipeline with Cell Therapies to produce clinical-grade red blood cell-derived extracellular vesicles (RBC-EV) for downstream safety and efficacy testing, aiming to advance towards a Phase I clinical trial for an accessible, safe, and anti-inflammatory treatment for retinal degenerations.

Title: Quantum voltage imaging assays for neuro-pharmacology
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a quantum voltage imaging platform to advance drug development for neurological disorders, enabling neuroscientists to discover new ways to understand and treat diseases such as epilepsy, Alzheimer's, and motor-neuron disease.

Title: Verification of a handheld prototype to measure brain pressure
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a portable and compact device for quick, accessible, and objective brain pressure checks to monitor concussed athletes at the time and location of injury, ensuring a safe return-to-play and peace of mind.

Title: Development of a Novel Turbostratic Carbon Film for Electrode Materials in Batteries and Supercapacitors
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop Turbostratic Carbon Films as a new electrode material for batteries and supercapacitors, aiming to significantly improve battery life, reduce charging times, and lower manufacturing costs by at least 30%.

Title: BenPol technology for management of cotton bollworm and western flower thrips
Description: The purpose of this project is to advance the patented novel material construct, BenPol, for efficient delivery of RNA interference (RNAi) technology to manage major agricultural pests, thereby enhancing Australia's agricultural productivity and sustainability.

Title: A Scalable Machine Learning Platform for Pharmaceutical Manufacture
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a software platform and synthesis protocols to create scalable chemical manufacturing processes for pharmaceutical products in Australia, combining novel chemistries with machine-learning and continuous flow technologies to enhance local pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Title: VisionSync: AI-Driven Sensor Fusion for Enhanced Driver Awareness and Safety
Description: The purpose of this project is to revolutionise road safety by developing an advanced system that leverages existing vehicle sensors to track a driver’s focus and identify potential hazards in real time.

Title: Commercialising Artificial Intelligence Methods for Detecting and Preventing Data Breaches in the Cloud
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop a cutting-edge artificial intelligence system to protect small and medium-sized businesses in various industries from data breaches in real-time, enabling them to safely manage sensitive information in the cloud without needing in-house cybersecurity expertise.

Title: A virtual training environment to improve workforce safety in the construction industry
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop an innovative virtual training platform for the construction industry, providing a realistic environment where workers can practice safety procedures, identify hazards, and manage risks in a setting that mirrors real-world conditions.

Title: IntelGrid: A Grid Intelligence Technology Enabling Efficient Integration of Renewables and Electric Vehicles
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: The project will deploy IntelGrid, an AI-powered platform for grid planning and operation. It will help energy distributors optimise networks, integrate renewables, and unlock capacity for solar and EVs. IntelGrid will reduce costs, support affordable electricity, and position Australia as a global leader in smart, sustainable energy infrastructure.

Title: Improving commercial outcomes for the tomato industry through enhanced vigour and grafting success
Description: The purpose of this project is to develop the best protocols for electrical treatment of tomato seeds and plants, leveraging Indigenous knowledge and modern science to improve plant growth and yield for the benefit of the tomato industry.

Title: Revolutionising Wind Energy: Smart Wind Turbine Blades for Enhanced Turbine Efficiency and Output
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: The project will deploy smart wind blade technology to boost turbine efficiency and reduce costs. Advanced blades and control software will enable safer operation in a broader range of wind conditions. Demonstration at Latrobe Regional Airport will accelerate commercialisation, support regional growth, and position Australia as a leader in resilient, low-cost renewable energy innovation.

Title: A new truly simple and affordable IoT soil moisture monitoring system: A world first shallow install sensor for deep rooted crops for smart farming
Description: The project will scale smart soil monitoring technology to reduce crop losses and water use. Using patented sensors and a user-friendly app, it will enable data-driven decisions for shallow and deep-rooted crops. This innovation will boost farm efficiency, support sustainability, and unlock significant savings across Australian agriculture.

Title: Scaling Up Sovereign Powder Manufacturing of Critical Materials Through Sustainable Advanced Materials Innovation
Description: The project will establish sovereign capability in high entropy materials (HEMs), enabling local design and manufacture of advanced alloys. SUT and EntroMat will deliver bespoke HEMs for harsh industrial environments, reducing reliance on imports, protecting IP, and positioning Australia as a leader in critical materials innovation.

Title: Building Faster and Greener: a Digitally-enabled Modular Production System for Rapid, Low Embodied Carbon Housing
Description: The project will develop ultra-low emission modular panels for rapid, affordable housing construction. In partnership with Spark Projects, pilot demonstrations will showcase advanced materials and smart curing methods. This innovation will reduce carbon emissions, accelerate prefab housing, and support Australia’s net-zero goals while expanding local manufacturing and job creation.

Title: Quantum Free-Space Adaptive Optics: Enabling quantum communication over turbulent channels
Description: This project aims to develop a new way to send secure messages using light through the air. By combining quantum technology with adaptive optics, it aims to protect information, even in challenging conditions, without using cables. It will demonstrate how quantum secure communication can work at scale for space and maritime use.

Title: Multiplexed Micro-physiological Perfusion System for Bioproduction and Drug Testing
Description: The project will commercialise an automated fluidic perfusion platform to enhance biomedical research and biomanufacturing. Pilot production and user studies will validate its impact. This innovation will accelerate drug development, reduce reliance on animal models, and strengthen Australia’s position in advanced biotech through industry collaboration and scalable technology.

Title: Scaling Australian critical mineral production through muon tomography
Description: The project will commercialise muon tomography for mineral exploration and mine safety. Swinburne and mDetect will deploy space-particle detectors to deliver non-invasive subsurface imaging. This will reduce exploration costs, improve safety, and unlock export and manufacturing opportunities - revolutionising mining with advanced, scalable technology made in Australia.

Title: NexusCharge: Intelligent Charging and Fleet Management for Electric Vehicles
University: The Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT)
Description: The project will scale NexusCharge, an AI-powered platform enabling precise EV transition planning and fleet management. It will help organisations streamline operations, reduce emissions, and meet sustainability goals. NexusCharge will accelerate corporate fleet electrification, supporting Australia’s shift to zero-carbon transport and a net-zero future.

Title: SWER Broken Conductor: Proofing scale for commercialisation
Description: The project will deploy conductor breakage detection devices across regional SWER networks to reduce fire risks. AI-driven diagnostics and commercial design will enhance safety, reliability, and asset monitoring. This innovation will support renewable energy, protect ecosystems, and position Australia as a global leader in rural powerline safety technology.

Title: RoadSense Analytics (RSA): AI-enabled Traffic Intelligence
Description: The project will advance RSA, an AI-powered video analytics tool, to market-ready status. It will deliver deep traffic insights, reduce accidents, and optimise infrastructure. RSA will support Vision Zero, Net Zero, and Smart Cities goals, positioning Australia as a global leader in intelligent transport and complex video analysis.

Title: Development and Implementation of High-Throughput JPEG 2000 (HTJ2K) Hardware Encoder and Decoder with Code-block Caching Support
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: This project will build a fast and energy-efficient image compression system for high-quality pictures and videos. Using new hardware, it will speed up a powerful tool called HTJ2K. The team will create a ready-to-use solution for industries like medical imaging, defence, and video storage, helping them work faster and smarter.

Title: Facile water-based polyethylene terephthalate (PET) recycling for innovative packaging
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: This project will develop a new way to recycle plastic bottles, even coloured ones, into high-quality material. Using a patented method from UNSW, it will remove dyes from the plastic waste and turn it into clean powder that can be reused. The team will scale up the technology to help Australia recycle more and reduce plastic pollution.

Title: Long Range Wi-Fi systems for Underground Mines and other Large Industry Settings
Description: This project will build a new WiFi system that works over long distances, even in underground mines. It uses regular WiFi chips to keep costs low and has already shown great results. The team will improve and launch the system to boost safety and connectivity in mining and other large industries.

Title: Commercialisation of a novel conductive polymer for next-generation solar modules
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: This project aims to commercialise novel conductive polymers for the fabrication of next-generation Si-based tandem solar panels and building integrated photovoltaic products. The material is clear, strong, and can carry electricity. The team will scale up production to make solar panels that are cheaper and more powerful, helping Australia make clean energy and create new jobs.

Title: Operationalisation of a sovereign Autonomous Underwater Vehicle capability
Description: This project will launch a smart underwater robot that can take clear pictures of the seafloor, even in tricky areas. Built at the University of Sydney, the robot is small, easy to carry, and highly manoeuvrable. The team will test and improve it for use in defence, energy, and ocean surveys.

Title: Commercialising quantum computer readout subsystems
Description: This project will build powerful quantum amplifiers—tiny devices that help quantum computers work better. Made in Australia, they will be used in defence, science, and tech. The team will set up new ways to make and package these devices, helping Australia lead in global quantum innovation and manufacturing.

Title: Single Stage Production of Ultrahigh Grade Minerals
Description: This project will create a new way to recover valuable minerals like tin and manganese, even from mining waste. Using a smart mixing system, it will help separate tiny mineral particles more effectively. The team will work with industry to build the technology, boosting clean mining and creating new job opportunities.

Title: Ultra-Wide Band Based Collision Awareness System
University: The University of New South Wales
Description: This project will improve safety in places like mines and warehouses by helping machines and people avoid crashes. It uses a smart tracking system based on Ultra-Wide Band technology. The team will upgrade the system and work with industry to launch it, making workplaces safer and more efficient.

Title: Autonomous Drone Battery Swap
Description: This project will create a smart drone system that swaps batteries mid-air to fly longer. Using AI and special hardware, one drone gives a fresh battery to another while removing the old one. Partnering with DroneX, the team aims to launch a startup, Dronergy, to bring this breakthrough to market.

Title: SPARC-H2: Build and demonstration of a zero-electricity, solar hydrogen reactor which will produce low-cost, clean green hydrogen at commercial scale
Description: This project will build a new hydrogen system that uses only sunlight, water, and a highly specialised photocatalyst. It will help make clean hydrogen for industries like mining and steel. The team will test the technology to show it works at scale, helping Australia lead in green energy and cut emissions.

Title: Manufacturing of advanced green lixiviant from biomass resources for circular critical metal production and recovery
Description: The project will commercialise a new metal extracting technology to reduce carbon emissions using a biodegradable biomass-based leaching agent for use in critical metal extraction.

Title: Commercialisation of novel AI-assisted functional imaging technologies for understanding lung disease
Description: This project will use smart software to help doctors better understand how lungs work. By combining AI with low-radiation scans, the team will create safer, more accurate lung tests, especially helpful for children. The system will be tested and improved to help patients get better care without needing extra scans.

Title: Multi-Robot Mission Control System for Autonomous Systems – Integration & Mission Demonstration
Description: This project will build smart software to help one person control several robots at once. Developed by UTS and Navantia Australia, it will support defence and other industries. The system will be tested in real-world missions and made ready for global markets, helping Australia lead in robot teamwork technology.

Title: AI Driven Diagnostics and Predictive Maintenance of solar farms using SolarisAI Platform
Description: This project will roll out smart software to help solar farms run better. SolarisAI uses AI to spot problems early and keep panels working at their best, without needing extra hardware. The team will test it on real farms, helping save energy, cut costs, and boost clean power across Australia.

Title: Cost effective and portable low-field musculoskeletal MRI for high performance sport
Description: This project will build a small, mobile MRI machine to help athletes check their muscles and joints where they train. It will use smart software and advanced imaging to spot injuries early and track recovery. The team will test the device to improve athlete health and performance.

Title: Advanced manufacturing of high-value organic fragrances from sugarcane feedstocks
Description: This project will make safe, high-quality perfume ingredients from sugar cane using engineered microbes. Instead of using plants or petroleum, the team will use precision fermentation to produce the fragrance in labs. They will build and test the system for large-scale production, helping Australia turn sugar into valuable products and grow a green industry.

Title: An Intelligent, Adaptable, and User-Friendly Weed Management system
Description: This project will help farmers fight weeds using smart drones and AI. The system will find weeds and spray only where needed, saving money and protecting the environment. The team will test it on farms, improve its accuracy, and prepare it for wide use to support cleaner, more efficient agriculture.

Title: High value-added manufacturing of specialty alumina products
Description: This project will create special high purity alumina materials used in batteries and high-tech products. Made from mining waste, the alumina will be improved to work better in energy, defence, and manufacturing. The team will build and test the materials in Australia, helping secure supply chains and support clean energy and new jobs.

Title: Olives the Australian Way - A pre-commercial demonstration of a novel debittering process for a new style of table olive
Description: This project will bring a modified kind of table olive to market—fresh, fruity, and ready to eat in under six months. Using a patented process from UniSA, the team will prove the non toxic system at scale in South Australia. It could double olive farming in Australia and grow a billion-dollar industry.

Title: Novel Superconducting Quantum Interference Device (SQUID) Array Technology for Ultrasensitive Signal Sensing.
Description: This project will build powerful new antennas that can hear even the faintest signals. Using quantum technology, they will help defence and communication systems work faster and smarter. The team will test the antennas in real-world settings, aiming to replace older systems and boost Australia’s tech leadership.

Title: Developing Australian meat into the world’s best product with an artificial intelligence-enabled meat scanner
Description: This project will build a smart tool to quickly check meat quality in processing plants. Using a tiny probe and AI, it will help find premium meat and give farmers feedback to improve livestock. The team will test it across Australia, aiming to launch into a global market.

Title: Commercially viable product development for scalable accessible space photovoltaics
Description: This project will build new solar cells for satellites that are cheaper, lighter, and work better in space. Made from special materials called perovskites, they resist space damage and make more power. The team will improve the design and test it with users, helping grow Australia’s space energy industry.

Title: Sub-100 nm feature wafer-scale manufacturing for clinical scale biophotonics
Description: This project will build Australia’s first facility to make tiny medical devices at scale. Using advanced technology, it will help create smart microscope slides that can detect cancer. The team will test the system for safe, large-scale production, helping bring new health tools to market and grow local manufacturing.

Title: Fully integrated digital technology solution for enhanced dairy farm management
Description: The project will integrate drone and wearable tech to deliver a digital twin for dairy farm management. Advancing from TRL 6 to 8, it will help farmers reduce costs and boost milk yields by combining pasture, health, and production data into one powerful decision-support platform.

Title: Autonomous Ground Uncrewed System for Intelligent Surveillance
Description: This project will upgrade a rugged robot called GUS to work on its own in dangerous places. It will carry power and equipment, spot threats using AI, and help keep people safe. The team will test it in real-world missions, with strong support from the Australian Army for defence use.

Title: Maturing Quantum Sensors to Match Real-World Needs
Description: This project will build powerful sensors that can detect things underground, underwater, and where current technology doesn’t work. Using quantum technology, they will help find minerals, improve navigation, and protect communication systems. The team will make the sensors smaller, cheaper, more efficient and ready for real-world use, helping Australia lead in this growing field.

Title: Sovereign sodium-ion battery manufacturing
Description: This project will build safer, more sustainable batteries using sodium instead of lithium. Developed by Deakin University, the new design lowers fire risk and uses innovative electrolyte materials to improve performance. The team will work with industry to get the batteries ready for manufacturing and help Australia lead in clean energy storage.

Title: Development, validation and scale-up of smoke taint prediction technology for the Australian wine industry and wine producers globally
Description: The project will finalise and provide proof of scale Wine Industry Smoke Detectors (WISDs), enabling real-time smoke taint risk prediction. Growers will make early, confident decisions during smoke events, reducing losses and improving grape quality. WISDs will be validated nationally and integrated into smart viticulture systems for domestic and international deployment.
